artifacts_to_persist: Pinned script, protocol commit, source/artifact receipts, full predictions, actual loaded parameter counts, dtype/device, source-to-runtime tokenizer hashes and failure traceback if any.
controls: Explicit CPU and eager backend; one route loaded at a time.
Use isolated copied metadata/tokenizers so vendor compatibility rewrites cannot alter source cache bytes.
Verify pinned original payload digests before loading; weights reference unchanged verified shared cache files.
Offline guards; no credentials, remote model requests, GPU execution, fitting or calibration.
data: One explicitly synthetic non-sensitive customer-service smoke state; identical mixed typed questions for every route. Fixture bytes are pinned by script hash and persisted in receipt. No dataset/final pool opened.
failure_branches: Persist full traceback and completed-route outputs.
Diagnose dependency/API incompatibility; use a separately pinned environment if required, without upgrading the active training environment.
Missing/corrupt artifact remains fail-closed; never silently substitute another checkpoint or tokenizer.
hypothesis: Pinned current Laya source and all three reviewed checkpoint routes can load offline on the existing local CPU runtime and return valid Choice/Noul/Score payloads.
primary_metric: All three routes load and complete one mixed Choice/Noul/Score request with finite, bounded, normalized output payloads.

promotion_gates.integration_compatibility: All three reviewed routes load and return valid typed predictions.

scope: Integration compatibility only; no benchmark quality, calibration, latency or footprint conclusion.
secondary_metrics: Actual live parameter count after successful loading, distinguished from stored scalar counts.
Record actual dtype, CPU device and any vendor tokenizer compatibility rewrite.
seed: No sampling, optimization or quality selection.
splits_and_grouping: Not a generalization experiment; no train/dev/cal/final allocation or statistical independence claim.
statistical_test: Not applicable to compatibility smoke; no inferential quality test.
